output.reason: The linked issue [ev-293cba9e28f6] names the subject and the change concretely: the ApplicationSet matrix/merge generator field `applyNestedSelectors` is dropped, and `true` (applying selectors on nested generators) becomes the default and only behavior. Before this, applying them was optional to keep backwards compatibility. The PR [ev-15936265edd6] closes that issue and marks it breaking ('!'). Its changed files [ev-f5ff9ce56464] touch matrix.go, merge.go, the ApplicationSet types and the 2.14-3.0 upgrade guide, which confirms the scope. Exposed environments are ApplicationSets whose matrix/merge generators have nested generators with selectors and did not set applyNestedSelectors: true. Those selectors now filter the generated parameters. The evidence does not spell out the downstream effect on generated Applications, and the upgrade-guide text is not shown, so confidence is low.
